notes.title: Condition Red 1.07.3
notes.content:
Crosshairs are once again hidden during reloading.
Meshes replaced and some materials and textures have been updated. HUD tweaks.
Splash sound when entering and exiting water functional again.
Fast turn in depth (2.5D) shooting mode will allow toggle camera position from left to right and v.v.
Fast turn and forwards/backwards roll keys on gamepad swapped.
Reduced memory footprint for levels 01 . There should no longer be texture blurring for background objects with a 2GB video card in level 01.
Minor tweaks to geometry in level 01. These changes should be unnoticeable during play.
